definition: A software development practice in which a developer works alongside an AI coding assistant that suggests code, explains logic, and helps debug in real time.
details: AI pair programming tools integrate directly into development environments, offering context-aware code suggestions and assistance that aim to complement, rather than fully replace, a human developer's judgment and oversight.
story: Picture a scoreboard at a science fair: you need a fair, agreed way to tell who actually won. Boil it down and it is this: A software development practice in which a developer works alongside an AI coding assistant that suggests code, explains logic, and helps debug in real time. Here is why it matters: AI pair programming tools integrate directly into development environments, offering context-aware code suggestions and assistance that aim to complement, rather than fully replace, a human developer's judgment and oversight. A good metric is a ruler that does not bend when you lean on it. That shared ruler is AI Pair Programming.
